description:
FILED s543j (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22) while writing Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M8 (its program was re-spelled with qualified `sub TA::NAME` definitions to sidestep this).  The test harnesses that call Pl::Parser2->parse_code directly (local-elem-02.t run_pl and others) see it; the pl2cl binary emits the main package (the program path).

REPRODUCER: a file `{ package TA; sub f { 1 } } print TA::f(), "\n";` -- `perl -e 'use lib "."; use Pl::Parser2; local $/; open my $f, "<", $ARGV[0]; print Pl::Parser2->parse_code(<$f>)' FILE | grep -n defpackage` lists only TA; `sbcl --load` of it dies at the first `(in-package :main)`.  `./runpcl FILE` prints 1.

Not a user-visible defect of the compiler path; a harness trap (a row that opens with a package block fails for a reason unrelated to its subject).
subject: LOUD (tooling): Pl::Parser2->parse_code of a program that OPENS with a package block (`{ package TA; ... } tie my @a, q(TA); ...`) emits `(in-package :main)` with no `(p-defpackage :main)` -- the --load dies "The name MAIN does not designate any package"; pl2cl / runpcl of the same text are right
triage_reason: test-harness path only (parse_code), the program path is right
